name: Yamaha LT2 / LT3 100 Enduro
engine: 97 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, rotary valve, Autolube
intro: Small two-stroke enduros between the mini enduros and the DT125. Light and easy to fix.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
